zh: 这种药有什么副作用吗？
en: Does this medicine have any {side effects}?

zh: 她这周在休病假。
en: She's on {sick leave} this week.

zh: 医生说我的血压有点高。
en: The doctor said my {blood pressure} is a bit high.

zh: 我嗓子疼，还有点咳嗽。
en: I've got a {sore throat} and a bit of a cough.

zh: 病假超过三天需要医生开的病假证明。
en: You need a {medical certificate|doctor's certificate|doctor's note|sick note} if you're off sick for more than three days.

zh: 我儿子流鼻涕，还一直打喷嚏。
en: My son has a {runny nose} and keeps sneezing.

zh: 医生让我明天去验血。
en: The doctor wants me to have a {blood test} tomorrow.

zh: 这个手术要在等候名单上排六个月。
en: There's a six-month {waiting list|wait list|waitlist} for this operation.

zh: 一到春天我的花粉症就很严重。
en: My {hay fever} gets really bad every spring.

zh: 我吃了不新鲜的海鲜，食物中毒了。
en: I got {food poisoning} from some bad seafood.

zh: 他父亲去年心脏病发作过一次。
en: His father had a {heart attack} last year.

zh: 运动对心理健康很有好处。
en: Exercise is really good for your {mental health}.

zh: 车里最好放一个急救包。
en: It's a good idea to keep a {first aid kit|first-aid kit} in the car.

zh: 他摔断了胳膊，我们带他去了急诊科。
en: He broke his arm, so we took him to the {emergency department|emergency room|ER}.

zh: 公司给我买了医疗保险。
en: My company pays for my {health insurance|medical insurance}.

zh: 我每年入冬前都打一针流感疫苗。
en: I get a {flu jab|flu shot|flu vaccine|flu vaccination} every year before winter.

zh: 她吃了花生后出现了过敏反应。
en: She had an {allergic reaction} after eating peanuts.

zh: 医生问了我的病史。
en: The doctor asked about my {medical history}.

zh: 健康的饮食和充足的睡眠非常重要。
en: A {healthy diet|balanced diet} and enough sleep are really important.

zh: 我周三上午约了看医生。
en: I've got a {doctor's appointment|GP appointment|doctor appointment} on Wednesday morning.

zh: 我吃得太多了，现在肚子疼。
en: I ate too much and now I've got a {stomach ache|stomachache|stomach-ache|tummy ache}.

zh: 我想再找一位医生，听听第二意见。
en: I'd like to get a {second opinion} from another doctor.

zh: 请在候诊室坐一下，护士会叫您。
en: Please take a seat in the {waiting room} and the nurse will call you.

zh: 整天坐着让我背痛。
en: Sitting all day gives me {back pain|backache}.

zh: 我不想靠安眠药入睡。
en: I don't want to rely on {sleeping pills|sleeping tablets} to get to sleep.

zh: 他胆固醇偏高，得少吃油炸食品。
en: He has {high cholesterol}, so he has to cut down on fried food.

zh: 我的药快吃完了，需要医生续开一次处方。
en: I'm running out of tablets, so I need a {repeat prescription}.

zh: 我看东西有点模糊，该预约验光了。
en: Things look a bit blurry, so I should book an {eye test|eye exam|eye examination}.

zh: 我得了重感冒，在床上躺了两天。
en: I had a {bad cold|heavy cold} and stayed in bed for two days.

zh: 我下周要去拔智齿。
en: I'm getting my {wisdom teeth} out next week.
